falsification.mutation: Replace hydrateFilters() final applyFilters() call with updateUrl(), leaving parsed URL values but skipping card visibility and count synchronization.
falsification.red_evidence: After rebuilding the mutant, Chromium loaded ?q=review with the input set to review but count 16 and 16 visible cards instead of four.
falsification.restored_green_evidence: After restoring applyFilters() and rebuilding, a fresh Chromium session loaded ?q=review with count 4 and four visible cards.

behavioral_strength.evidence: The real browser producer covered the modeled transitions, the hydration mutant failed at the intended user-visible assertion, the restored artifact passed, and storage denial surfaced and drove the exact-head fix.

assumptions.claim: A build-time registry snapshot is preferable to a runtime GitHub dependency for this landing.
assumptions.evidence: The static build imports foundry/maturity.json, emits the current 16-skill release, and requires no runtime network call.

assumptions.claim: Distribution channel and evidence maturity remain separate concepts.
assumptions.evidence: The catalog renders and explains channel and maturity independently from distinct registry fields.

assumptions.claim: Keeping the Astro app under www avoids changing skill distribution behavior.
assumptions.evidence: All existing repository validators and 19 tests pass, while CI adds isolated install, check, and build steps under www.

side_effects.evidence: The only durable effect is the user's theme preference in origin-scoped localStorage. URL history replacement, clipboard writes on explicit copy, and DOM state are session or user-mediated browser effects rather than server state.

commit_points.effect: Persist or clear the origin-scoped railly-skills-theme preference.

findings.claim: When localStorage rejects a theme write, the document theme changed but the visible theme label stayed stale because the event handler threw before renderTheme().
findings.evidence: Chromium with Storage.prototype.setItem forced to throw moved data-theme from light to dark while the label remained Light. Exact HEAD wraps storage writes and now cycles label and dataset through Light, Dark, and System under denied storage.
findings.layer: browser theme interaction and durable preference boundary

findings.claim: The committed Bun lockfile embedded the Vercel laptop's authenticated corporate npm registry and could not install in GitHub Actions.
findings.evidence: Actions run 32784617256 returned 401 for registry.k8s.vercel-security.com. Exact HEAD contains no corporate registry URLs and a clean frozen install from registry.npmjs.org installed 272 packages before check and build passed.
